name: intensity-slider
title: Intensity Slider
description: A soft gradient slider in a card with a slim handle and a Low-to-High ruler that lights up to the value.

perf.budget: Dragging moves the handle and fill on the UI thread; React re-renders once per whole step to light the ruler.

a11y.reducedMotion: The handle does not grow while held and the fill settles without a spring.
a11y.screenReader: Adjustable role reading the value as a percentage; increment and decrement move by 5.
a11y.touchTarget: The track is 44 pt tall across the full width.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { IntensitySlider } from '@/components/kinetik/intensity-slider';

<IntensitySlider value={strength} onValueChange={setStrength} label="Blur" />;
```

## When to use

- A single 0–100 strength in an editor: effect intensity, blur, opacity, noise.
- Inside a popover opened from a toolbar value, as in the demo.

## When not to use

- Ranges that are not percentages: label the ends and format the value yourself, or use another slider.

## Notes

- The ruler lights up to the value and a haptic ticks each time the fill crosses a mark.
- `color` sets the fill; the handle uses the theme azure.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add intensity-slider`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
